// diagnostic

E1258

A sandbox can't use any effect.

What

A sandbox can't use any effect.

Why

This package builds as `target: sandbox` (D-PLUGIN1=B) — sandboxes run with zero host authority (the wasmtime host registers no host imports), so any effect (`FS`/`Net`/`DB`/…) would fail to instantiate at load time. There is no gate or grant to widen this (I1: the sandbox is the safety boundary, not an opt-in).

Fix

Remove the effectful call, or move it out of the sandbox into the host program that loads it.
